newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan '97 domestic car demand to dip - dealer group.
newsitem.headline: Japan '97 domestic car demand to dip - dealer group.

text.p: The Japan Automobile Dealers Association (JADA) said on Friday it estimated Japan's domestic vehicle demand, excluding 660cc mini vehicles, at 5.22 million units in calendar 1997, down 2.9 percent from a year earlier.
Japan's domestic vehicle sales in 1996 rose 4.4 percent from a year earlier to 5.37 million units.

The association attributed the prospective decline to a likely fall-off in consumption after this April's scheduled increase in the national sales tax, despite strong sales in the run-up to the tax increase.
